title: Lee et al. 2019 (ERP) — EEG dataset and OpenBMI toolbox for three BCI paradigms: an investigation into BCI illiteracy
description: EEG recordings from 54 healthy participants performing a 36-symbol ERP (P300) row-column speller task with face stimuli, across two sessions with offline training and online copy-spelling test phases. Data were recorded with 62 EEG channels and 4 EMG channels at 1000 Hz. The dataset is one of three BCI paradigms (ERP, SSVEP, motor imagery) released with the OpenBMI toolbox to investigate BCI illiteracy. This is a MOABB-generated BIDS conversion of the original GigaDB data (10.5524/100542).
methods_description: EEG was recorded with a BrainAmp amplifier and Brain Products Ag/AgCl cap (62 EEG and 4 EMG channels, 1000 Hz, reference at nasion, ground AFz, impedance below 10 kOhm). Participants copy-spelled sentences by gazing at target characters in a random-set row-column speller with face stimuli (SOA 215 ms, ISI 135 ms, 5 sequences of 12 flashes per character), and counted target flashes. Training used 33 characters and the online test used 36 characters.
